card.text: Uranus's second-largest moon, heavily cratered and about half ice, half rock.

introduction.text: Oberon has at least one large mountain, about 6 km high. Little was known about it before Voyager 2 flew past.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Lighting is corrected, but terrain shadows and seams in the photographs remain.

voyager-color.title: Voyager color map
voyager-color.summary: Voyager's own color frames, 22 km per pixel, placed by the moon's limb; the unlit north stays unavailable.
